findings.title: Materials' 50-point lens gap is a margin-recovery bet
findings.body: Materials trades at 17.40x forward but 38.13x trailing, a 54 percent compression that implies 119 percent earnings growth. The market is underwriting a full earnings recovery from a depressed base, not a structural re-rating.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' forward percentile collapses while trailing stays rich
findings.body: Staples' forward multiple sits at percentile 28 after a 14-point monthly cheapening, yet its trailing P/E remains at percentile 84. Analysts are pricing in 44 percent earnings growth that would justify the compression, but the market is already discounting that optimism.

findings.title: Communication Services sits at a five-year forward low
findings.body: At a forward P/E of 13.84 and percentile 1, Communication Services is the cheapest it has been in five years on forward earnings, despite a trailing percentile of 27. The 35 percent multiple compression implies 55 percent growth, a steep hurdle that the market is not yet rewarding.
